verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a contract-workflow platform, but the evidence never mentions scheduling, recurrence, or cron-style triggers. The docs only cover on-demand actions: launching or bulk-launching workflows via the REST API, triggering export jobs by API request, and receiving event-driven webhooks. A user would have to build any scheduling themselves with an external scheduler calling the API, and nothing in the evidence shows the product offering that.
